I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. That message also corrected an early mix-up with Tansley Parcel, so I'm confident it's the right account.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used a channel he can see himself. A ticket number is account information, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share it with his team. I didn't find a Tansleigh account folder in the shared files, so this channel message is the only source for the number.
